params.name: query
params.description: the search query

params.name: limit
params.description:
Optional limit for the number of results returned (non-paginated mode only).
Cannot be combined with page — when page is provided, use pageSize instead.

params.name: displayClientCallSign
params.description: when true, search by client.callSign instead of initiative callSign

params.name: page
params.description:
Optional page number for paginated results (1-indexed).
When omitted, pagination is disabled and results are returned as a flat array
to preserve backward compatibility with existing consumers.

params.name: pageSize
params.description:
Optional page size for paginated results. Requires page to be set.
Defaults to 50 to match the previous maximumSearchLimit, preserving the same
result count that existing consumers received before pagination was introduced.

params.name: workDate
params.description: When set (and restrictions are enabled), excludes initiatives restricted on this date.

params.name: customerId
params.description: customer's id

params.name: userId
params.description: user's id
